name: Changelog Auto-Update
description: Automatically appends feature and fix entries to CHANGELOG.md after git commits with conventional commit messages
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Append to CHANGELOG.md after feature/fix commits
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit'; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  CHANGELOG="$ROOT/CHANGELOG.md"
  # Get the last commit message
  MSG=$(cd "$ROOT" && git log -1 --pretty=%s 2>/dev/null)
  if [[ -z "$MSG" ]]; then exit 0; fi
  # Only add entries for features and fixes
  if echo "$MSG" | grep -qE '^(feat|fix)'; then
    DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
    TYPE=$(echo "$MSG" | grep -oE '^(feat|fix)')
    if [[ "$TYPE" == "feat" ]]; then
      SECTION="### Added"
    else
      SECTION="### Fixed"
    fi
    if [[ -f "$CHANGELOG" ]]; then
      echo "Consider adding to CHANGELOG.md under $SECTION:"
      echo "- $MSG ($DATE)"
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
